name: retail_banking
title: Retail banking self-service
description: Customers calling about balances, cards, disputes or loans: containment, resolution, cross-sell and satisfaction.
notice: Operational analytics only. Do not use outputs for credit, fraud or eligibility decisions about a customer.

fields.instructions: What was the main reason the customer called?

criteria.card_issue: Card blocked, lost or not working
criteria.loan_enquiry: Asking about a loan or credit product
criteria.profile_update: Changing address, phone or other details

fields.instructions: The agent explicitly said identity verification was completed before stating any account-specific balance, transaction or card details.
The agent explicitly said the requested action was done on the call, such as a card blocked, a dispute opened or details updated.
The customer's request was handled by the virtual agent without a transfer to a human.
The customer explicitly asked to speak to a human agent.
The customer says a transaction on their account was unauthorized or incorrect.
The agent offered an additional product or service.
The customer explicitly agreed to the additional product or service offered.
The agent said a callback or follow-up contact was arranged.
What was the single main follow-up the agent agreed to?

criteria.replacement_or_delivery: Something will be sent, such as a new card

fields.instructions: Which phone number did the customer give for a callback?
Did the customer explicitly say how they felt about the call or the help they received?

criteria.positive: Explicitly satisfied or thankful for the help

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Welcome to Northwind Bank. This call is recorded. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My debit card stopped working at the store and I see a charge of $240 that I did not make.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. First, for security, can you confirm your date of birth and the last four digits of your card?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, 14 March 1988 and 4521.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you are verified. I have blocked the card and opened a dispute for the $240 charge. A new card will arrive in five days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Great. Can someone call me when the dispute is decided? My number is 415-555-0123.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, I have arranged a callback. Would you also like to hear about our travel rewards card?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No thanks, not now. But thanks for the quick help, that was easy.

name: insurance_claims
title: Insurance claims and policy servicing
description: First notice of loss, claim status and policy changes: intake, resolution, complaints and satisfaction.
notice: Operational analytics only. Do not use outputs to decide claim validity, fraud, severity or coverage.

fields.instructions: What was the main purpose of the call?
The agent explicitly said the caller was verified before discussing the policy or claim.
On which date did the customer say the incident happened?
What damage or claim amount did the customer state?
The agent explicitly said a claim was created or opened.
The agent gave the customer a claim or reference number.
The agent told the customer which documents or evidence are needed.
What claim status did the agent communicate?
Who does the next step fall to, according to the agent?
The agent gave the customer an expected timeframe for the next step.
The customer made a complaint, asked for a supervisor, or mentioned a regulator or legal action.
The customer's request was completed on this call.
Did the customer explicitly say how they felt about the call or the help they received?

criteria.positive: Explicitly satisfied or thankful for the help

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Contoso Insurance. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to report an accident. Someone hit my parked car on 2 October.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. First I need to verify you. Can I have your policy holder name and date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Priya Nair, 9 July 1990.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you are verified. Was anyone injured, and do you have an estimate of the damage?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No injuries. The repair shop says about $1,800.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have opened your claim and your claim number is CL-48213. Please upload photos and the police report. An adjuster will contact you within two business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, that's clear. Thanks, this was much easier than I expected.

name: patient_access
title: Patient access and scheduling
description: Booking, rescheduling and cancelling appointments: scheduling outcomes, verification, safe routing and patient experience.
notice: Scheduling and call quality only. Not for triage, diagnosis or clinical decisions. Minimise and protect health information.

fields.instructions: What did the caller want to do?

criteria.refill_or_results: Ask about a refill or results

fields.instructions: What was the scheduling outcome of the call?
The agent explicitly said the caller was verified before sharing appointment or patient details.
The agent explicitly confirmed a booked appointment.
Which appointment date was agreed?
The caller explicitly asked for urgent or same-day care, or said they cannot wait.
The agent explicitly directed the caller to emergency services, a nurse line or clinical staff.
The agent collected or confirmed the patient's insurance details.
The agent offered a waitlist, a different slot or another provider when the first choice was unavailable.
The caller explicitly agreed to receive appointment reminders.
Which phone number did the caller give for reminders?
Did the caller explicitly say how they felt about the call or the help they received?

criteria.positive: Explicitly satisfied or thankful for the help

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Fabrikam Clinic. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'd like to book a check-up with Dr. Rao, sometime next week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Of course. Can I have your full name and date of birth to find your record?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Arjun Mehta, 22 January 1984.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you are verified. Dr. Rao has 3 pm on 15 October. Does that work?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that works. Please send me a reminder at 206-555-0148.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Done. You are booked for 15 October at 3 pm and you will get a text reminder. Is your insurance still with Contoso Health?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes it is. Thanks, that was quick and simple.

name: health_plan_member
title: Health-plan member services
description: Member calls about benefits, claims, ID cards, provider search and prior authorization: first-call resolution, compliance and effort.
notice: Operational analytics only. Do not use outputs to decide coverage, authorization or appeals.

fields.instructions: What was the main reason the member called?
The agent explicitly said the member was verified before sharing plan or claim details.
The agent explicitly provided the requested information or completed the requested action.
The member's request was fully completed on this call without needing a callback or another contact.
The member said they had already contacted the plan about this same issue.
The member said they want to file a complaint, grievance or appeal.
The agent stated how or where the member can file a grievance or appeal.
The agent said a grievance or complaint was logged on the call.
Who does the next step fall to, according to the agent?
The call was transferred to another person or department.
The member explicitly said getting help was hard, slow or frustrating.
What follow-up or decision date did the agent give?
Did the member explicitly say how they felt about the call or the help they received?

criteria.positive: Explicitly satisfied or thankful for the help

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Adatum Health Plan member services. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm calling about a claim for my knee MRI. I called last week and nobody got back to me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry about that. Can I confirm your member ID and date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: ID is AB123456 and I was born on 3 May 1975.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, you are verified. The claim was received and is under review. You should have a decision by 20 October.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is a long time. I want to file a complaint about the delay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. I have logged a grievance for you now, and you can also file it online at the member portal under Appeals. You will receive a letter with the steps.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. This has been frustrating, but thank you for explaining.

name: airline_travel
title: Airline and travel servicing
description: Changes, cancellations, disruptions and baggage: rebooking and refund outcomes, support offered, ancillary revenue and satisfaction.

fields.instructions: What was the main reason the customer called?

criteria.cancel_refund: Cancel and ask for a refund

fields.instructions: The customer's main request was completed on this call.
What happened with rebooking or changing the flight?

criteria.not_applicable: No rebooking was needed or discussed
criteria.confirmed: A new flight or date was confirmed
criteria.offered_not_accepted: Options were offered but not accepted

fields.instructions: What was the original or affected travel date the customer mentioned?
What new travel date did the agent confirm for the customer?
What did the agent say about a refund?

criteria.partial_or_credit: Partial refund or travel credit offered

fields.instructions: What fee or fare difference amount did the agent quote?
What disruption support did the agent offer?
The agent offered a paid extra such as an upgrade, bag or seat.
The customer explicitly agreed to buy the offered extra.
The customer asked for a supervisor or manager.
The customer said they would switch airlines or complain publicly.
Did the customer explicitly say how they felt about the call or the help they received?

criteria.positive: Explicitly satisfied or thankful for the help

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling Tailwind Airlines. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My flight on 18 October was cancelled. I need to get to Seattle as soon as possible.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry. I can rebook you on the 6 am flight on 19 October at no charge, and I can add a $15 meal voucher.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The 19 October flight is fine. Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You are confirmed. Would you like extra legroom for $39?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, add that.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Done. Your new itinerary will be emailed to you.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Perfect, that was handled well. Thanks.

title: Multilingual travel concierge

fields.instructions: Which language did the customer explicitly choose or mainly use for the conversation?

criteria.no_preference_stated: No language choice or clear main language

fields.instructions: The customer or agent explicitly asked to switch to a different language.

What budget amount did the customer state?

name: ai_tutor
title: AI tutor and role-play coach
description: Tutoring and practice sessions: goal setting, practice, feedback, goal completion and learner satisfaction.
notice: For improving the learning experience only. Do not use outputs to grade, rank or make decisions about learners.

fields.instructions: What kind of session was this?

criteria.concept_help: Explaining a concept or answering questions

fields.instructions: The learner stated a goal for the session.
The learner attempted answers or role-play turns rather than only listening.
The tutor gave specific feedback on something the learner said or answered.
The learner tried again, restated or applied the point after the tutor's feedback.
The tutor changed the difficulty or approach after the learner struggled or asked.
The learner said they were confused, stuck or frustrated.
The learner explicitly said their session goal was met.
The learner agreed to a next session, practice task or follow-up.
Did the learner explicitly say how they felt about the session?

criteria.positive: Explicitly said it was helpful or thanked the tutor

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Hi, I want to practice a job interview for a product manager role.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Great, let's start. Tell me about a product you improved and how you measured success.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: I redesigned onboarding and activation went up by twenty percent.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Good start. Next time state the baseline and the timeframe. Try again with those.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Activation was thirty percent and rose to thirty-six percent in two months.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: Much better. Shall we practice a harder question about prioritization tomorrow?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Yes please. I got what I wanted from this session, and it was really helpful, thank you.

name: recruiting_assessment
title: Recruiting and employee assessment
description: Recruiter screens and assessment calls: process quality, scheduling, consent and candidate experience. Not for scoring candidates.
notice: Process and candidate-experience analytics only. Do not score, rank, screen out or infer traits about candidates or employees. Human decision-makers only.

fields.instructions: The recruiter told the candidate the call is recorded or assessed and the candidate agreed.
The recruiter described the role.
The recruiter described the steps of the hiring process.
The candidate explicitly said they are interested in continuing.
Did the recruiter answer the questions the candidate asked?

criteria.all: Every candidate question was answered or a follow-up was promised
criteria.some: Some candidate questions were left unanswered
criteria.none: None of the candidate questions were answered

fields.instructions: The recruiter confirmed a specific date and time for the next step.
Which date was agreed for the next step?
The recruiter told the candidate what happens next and when.
The recruiter asked the candidate about a topic not allowed by policy, such as age, marital status, religion or health.
Which email address did the candidate give for follow-up?
Did the candidate explicitly say how they felt about the experience of the call?

criteria.positive: Explicitly said it was a good experience or thanked the recruiter

turns.speaker: recruiter
turns.text: Hi Sam, this is Maya from Fabrikam. This call is recorded for quality. Is that okay with you?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, that's fine.

turns.speaker: recruiter
turns.text: Great. The role is Senior Data Analyst. The process is this screen, a technical interview, then a panel. Are you still interested?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, definitely. What is the team size?

turns.speaker: recruiter
turns.text: The team has eight people. Can we schedule the technical interview for 14 October at 11 am?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: That works. You can reach me at sam.lee@example.com.

turns.speaker: recruiter
turns.text: I'll send the invite today. You will hear about the panel within a week.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Thanks, I appreciated how clear this was.
